title: L3 verifier reference verdict (O1 oracle)
description: The verifier's pre-runtime oracle verdict computed by a separate-file reference re-implementation with no shared imports from the production gate.
x-schema-changelog: v2: adds INVALID for verification-only oracles. The audit-chain oracle (tests/l3_reference/audit_chain.py) returns VALID|INVALID by design, so a reference verdict for a verification scenario could not previously be expressed. Matches l3-plan.schema.json v2, l3-runtime-verdict.schema.json v2, l3-verdict-match.schema.json v2 and claim_gate P1.

decision.description: ALLOW|DENY for execution gates; VALID|INVALID for integrity-verification gates (the audit-chain oracle returns VALID when the chain re-computes and INVALID on any mismatch).
